acts.title: Act I — the ghost
acts.subtitle: DAY limit, filled_qty 0. Naive records a short. FillTrue does not.

naive.note: Logged OPEN the moment submit returned. filled_qty is 0.

filltrue.note: Submitted. Not a fill. Ledger stays flat.

naive.note: Broker never sold the put. Naive ledger still showed a short.

filltrue.note: UNFILLED. Never OPEN. No leftover. No fake P&L.

acts.title: Act II — a real fill, then a stop
acts.subtitle: Same contract. This time the bid is hit. Stop is buy_to_close, not buy_to_open.

naive.note: Finally a real short. Naive got here by accident yesterday.

filltrue.note: filled_qty ≥ qty and avg price > 0. Now it is OPEN.

naive.note: A buy without buy_to_close can leave a leftover long put.

filltrue.note: position_intent=buy_to_close. Flat. Harvest when the reason to hold is gone.
